About

I'm Rudra, a self-taught graphic designer from Motihari, Bihar. I learned design on my own — starting on my phone, watching YouTube tutorials — because I wanted to build real skills and earn through my work. I design posters, ad creatives, logos and brand identities for small businesses: the kind of visuals that help a local shop, cafe or startup look professional and get customers. I keep my process simple and honest — clear prices, fixed revisions, on-time delivery.

Available for freelance and full-time opportunities.

Skills
Poster design, social media and ad creatives, logo design, brand identity, banners and flyers, YouTube banners and channel art, movie/album cover art, photo manipulation posters
Tools
Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop
Currently learning
UX Design (Google UX Design Certificate, Coursera)
